caption:
If your journal entries sound the same every night, it's not a discipline problem — it's a question problem. The same vague prompt produces the same vague answer on repeat. These four prompts each have a target, a constraint, and an endpoint — DM "JOURNAL" to get the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save these for tonight. Send them to someone whose entries all sound the same.
